system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: These agents perform reasoning based on prompt templates and collaborate under the control of a Task Master.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper Fig. 2 shows a role/task/tool template; prompt code files (back/agent/detect_prompts.py) exist but were not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: It statically analyzes the APK to extract metadata, icons, permissions, and source code. The extracted information is processed by eight specialized agents
env_context_strategy.note: The harness injects static-analysis features up front. Paper Sec. III-A: agents can also 'search, navigate, and interpret program logic'. Closest-value fit, since this is an APK, not a repo.

observation_format.note: Paper Sec. III-C says analytical agents 'return structured results'; tool output format not shown.

tool_call_format.note: langchain-openai/langgraph in requirements suggests native function calling, but no parser code in evidence.

tool_count.note: back/agent/detect_tools.py and report_tools.py exist; contents not in evidence. Paper names get_icon_prob.

edit_primitive.note: The analysis-only domain probably has no edit tool, but this is unverified.

protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A dependency is listed in the README requirements list, but source was not grep-able.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: All agents communicate asynchronously via the LangGraph backend, and intermediate states are stored in memory to support iterative reasoning.
loop_primitives.note: Paper Algorithm 1 is a Task Master loop that assigns tasks until a decision can be made. It was coded as event_driven; the fit is weak. Algorithm 1 could arguably be plan_execute.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: tasksT oAssign← Analyze and determine new tasks

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Task Master: Assigns tasks to the appropriate agents and integrates their results for decision-making.
multi_agent_topology.note: Task Master plus 6 analysts plus a Decision Maker.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
the Task Master passes the consolidated infor-
mation to the Decision Maker
delegation_mechanism.note: LangGraph nodes share a state object; this is closer to role_handoff than subagent_spawn.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
which maintains a shared knowledge state ( collectedData)
that aggregates intermediate results

long_term_memory.note: back/relatedGraph/graph.json is a static app-relation graph used by the Link Analyst, not agent memory.

termination_condition.note: The loop ends when the Task Master judges it can decide. No caps are shown.

execution_isolation.note: Local Flask backend (python app.py). Agents call analysis tools rather than executing arbitrary actions.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on a 660-APK dataset; no evaluation runner was shown in the file tree evidence.

target_domain.evidence_quote: **AgentDroid** is a multi-agent detection tool for real-world fraudulent Android applications.

open_source.evidence_quote:
We have open-sourced our tool and dataset at https://
github.com/Wwstarry/LLM4Fraud.
open_source.note: No LICENSE file appears in the file tree, so OSI licensing is unverified.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
All the agents in AgentDroid
are powered by the GPT-4o model by default
model_agnostic.note: The requirements list langchain-openai; the provider abstraction was not inspected.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This tool is developed based on Large Language Models and the static analysis tool *Androguard*.
primary_artifact.note: Repo at main d23bf56d69ce postdates paper v2.

first_release_date.note: No tags or first-commit date appear in the evidence. Paper arXiv 2503.12163 (v1, March 2025) is noted only.

pinned_version.note: No tagged release; the full hash is not given.

stars.note: Retrieval date not stated in the evidence.
